{{ElectionsOH}}

The '''2022 Ohio Attorney General election''' took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the [[Ohio Attorney General|Attorney General]] of the [[U.S. state|state]] of [[Ohio]]. David Yost was re-elected to a second term in a landslide, defeating [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] opponent [[Jeffrey Crossman]] by a comfortable 20 percentage points. The election coincided with various other [[2022 United States elections|federal]] and [[2022 Ohio elections|state elections]], including that for [[2022 Ohio gubernatorial election|governor of Ohio]].
